text:
Claude half of the feasibility packet landed on local main by fast-forward to 7a53c481e (no push): docs/plans/2026-10-25-identity-feasibility-inputs.md, content-free.
Reviews: 32e9070a6 BLOCK (699 distinct rows not 702; name candidates not by the producer rule; section 4 not a faithful restatement), then 0f4c2b685 BLOCK (nine, not seven, refused-segment scenes), then 7a53c481e APPROVE WITH FOLLOW-UPS. The reviewer recomputed every number from the sources.
Findings:
(1) Word offsets derive exactly for 111 of 111 connected-run ASR records. The run-1 to media-part-a and run-2 to media-part-b identity crosswalk is declared in timebase-repair.json and confirmed on the data. All 858 record times are whole ticks, but they are JSON floats, so parse as Decimal. 159 manual-annotation records are mixed and refused; Codex's adapter keeps them annotation-origin.
(2) The clock is Princeton. The index origin is unsettled to within one TR: 98 boundary words are flagged, kept, and barred from inclusion and split decisions. gold_scene.py is a third convention (94 words).
(3) Scope over the 32 scenes NN03 recalls: 699 distinct rows; 30 unreviewed vocabulary entries; 390.75 s of refused long segments; ten zero-candidate scenes (2, 3, 4, 10, 11, 30, 36, 41, 42, 44); 2,455 recall words with 256 pronoun or noun tokens. Using Name-All presence beyond rows 500-585 needs an owner extension of ADR 0027 decision 1.
(4) Frozen criteria: 4.1 restates the epic notes clause by clause; 4.2 lists additions (unit, split, controls, the principle, the presence extension, and pseudonymization as the optional sensitivity check agreed with Codex).
Local artifacts: data/source-identity/feasibility/ (asr-record-offsets.json, scene-scope-cost-v2.json with build_scope_cost.py, tr-origin-sensitivity.json). Cosmetic follow-up: two wraps in sections 2 and 4.2.
